note: extractor_status='fully_supported_by_extractor' means no unsupported nodes were emitted; it is NOT contract 'verified' (which requires a source-fidelity check that every source child is accounted for). structural_status stays 'unverified' until that check exists. ast_hash is the canonical hash of the typed ExprNode; roundtrip_ok verifies to_dict->from_dict->hash invariance. Bounded operators carry explicit lower_bound/upper_bound child roles.
